messages:
Anita (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — we have an onramp request from LangChain for an orchestrator+gateway sandbox. Need checklist covering marketplace listing, SI enablement, HW partner validation, and coannounce timing. Who can own?
Mike (Eng-Platform): I can own the gateway adapter compatibility tests. Will need the connector spec and a sample helm chart.
Jia (Product): I'll own the marketplace metadata + SKU mapping. Rachel, can you draft coannounce copy after legal review?
Rachel (Marketing): Yep. Need embargo window and logo assets from LangChain. Tejas, can you nudge them for a small partner one-pager? :pray: 
Tejas (LangChain PM): On it. Will share logo + 1-pager by EOD Wed. Quick question: do you need our runner images or just the API shim?
Sam (Eng-ML): API shim is fine for sandbox smoke tests, but for HW partners we want runner images to validate quantized workloads on-device.
Anita (Partnerships): Good call. HW partners = Sigmacompute and EdgeBox — they asked for a 2-week validation window. Add to timeline.
Mike (Eng-Platform): For tests, I need a compat matrix doc. Can someone paste expected endpoints + feature flags? e.g., streaming, function-calls, kv-cache behavior.
Tejas (LangChain PM): Paste from our side:
```
POST /v1/generate -> streaming:true, streaming_chunk_size:256
POST /v1/call -> supports_tools:true
compat_versions: ["lc-0.34","lc-0.35"]
```
Use that for the matrix.
Sam (Eng-ML): Noted. For HW perf runs we'll supply a gbench harness. Mike, we should add a step to validate tokenization parity across models.
Mike (Eng-Platform): Adding tokenization parity test. Also provisioning note: sandbox cluster must have autoscale off to keep runs reproducible.
Jia (Product): Marketplace metadata draft (WIP):
```
product_name: "Redwood Orchestrator — LangChain Connector (Sandbox)"
sku_id: ORCH-LC-SBX-001
pricing_model: "free-trial then usage"
```
Will iterate.
Rachel (Marketing): Proposed coannounce: short blog + joint tweet + partner spotlight webinar. Recommend webinar 2 weeks after sandbox opens. Thoughts?
Anita (Partnerships): Agree. Let's lock webinar for T+14. Legal signoff required T+7. Tejas: any conflicts with LangChain roadmap?
Tejas (LangChain PM): T+14 ok. Legal will review assets; expect signoff T+5 if assets in by EOD Wed.
integration-bot: Deployment scheduled: sandbox-gateway-adapter v0.9.1 -> staging at 2025-08-02T18:30Z (deploy id: dpl_3491).
Mike (Eng-Platform): Thanks bot. After staging deploy we'll run the smoke matrix. Ping me when deploy complete.
Sam (Eng-ML): Who owns SI enablement doc? I can draft technical runbook for SIs and HW partners with sample infra diagrams.
Anita (Partnerships): Sam please draft SI runbook. Jia owns marketplace metadata. Mike owns compat tests and staging runs. Rachel owns comms. Tejas owns partner assets. I'll coordinate timeline and legal.
Tejas (LangChain PM): I've uploaded logo + 1-pager to the shared drive: https://drive.example/lc-partner-assets.
Rachel (Marketing): Got assets. Marking action: draft blog outline by Fri.
Jia (Product): One more ask — pricing/legal: do we need an explicit marketplace billing SKU to support reserved capacity trials for SIs?
Anita (Partnerships): Yes, add an enterprise trial SKU. Jia pls coordinate with finance.
Mike (Eng-Platform): Plan: run compatibility matrix after staging deploy, then a short perf matrix on EdgeBox with 3 payload sizes. Results will go to the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/partnerships/lc-sandbox.
Sam (Eng-ML): I'll prep gbench configs and attach expected upper/lower bounds.
Anita (Partnerships): Timeline recap:
- EOD Wed: LangChain assets in
- T+2 days: staging deploy and compat tests
- T+7 days: legal signoff
- T+14 days: webinar + joint announce
I'll create a calendar invite. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
